title: Gate Driver IC Market Size to Surpass USD 2.91 Billion by 2035 | Research by SNS Insider
author: Sns Insider

title: Should You Ignore Vertiv? Why ON Semiconductor May Be The Better AI Infrastructure Stock Today
author: Lee Samaha
description: The article compares Vertiv and ON Semiconductor as AI infrastructure plays. Vertiv offers stronger near-term exposure to the AI build-out phase with data center infrastructure, while ON Semiconductor provides better long-term potential through its positioning in physical AI (robotics, autonomous vehicles, edge computing) via its power/sensing business and the $7 billion Synaptics acquisition. ON Semiconductor trades at a significant valuation discount despite superior long-term growth prospects.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Vertiv is positioned as a strong near-term AI infrastructure play with certainty of medium-term growth, but the article suggests the stock may be overvalued relative to its growth prospects and worth avoiding on valuation grounds if no further upside is expected.

ON Semiconductor is presented as the more compelling long-term investment opportunity due to its exposure to physical AI through power/sensing solutions, the Synaptics acquisition filling gaps in edge AI computing, and significantly cheaper valuation despite strong future growth potential in autonomous driving and robotics.
Nvidia is mentioned as a technology partner for both Vertiv and ON Semiconductor in developing next-generation AI data center solutions, but is not the focus of the investment comparison.

Synaptics is viewed positively as a strategic acquisition by ON Semiconductor that adds critical edge AI computing capability, completing ON's portfolio for physical AI applications in robotics and autonomous systems.

title: Here's Why ON Semiconductor Just Made a $7 Billion Bet on AI
author: Lee Samaha
description: ON Semiconductor announced a $7 billion all-stock acquisition of AI edge solutions company Synaptics, transforming itself from a power and sensing chip company into one offering connected compute technology for physical AI applications. While the market initially reacted negatively, management expects the deal to add to earnings within 18 months, generate $200 million in synergies, and expand the company's total addressable market by $30 billion to $243 billion by 2030. The analyst views the stock dip as a buying opportunity, positioning the move as a bold but strategic entry into the long-term AI inference market.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The acquisition is framed as a strategic expansion into high-growth physical AI and edge inference markets. Management expects earnings accretion within 18 months, $200 million in synergies, and significant TAM expansion. The analyst recommends buying the dip, viewing the market sell-off as an overreaction to a bold but sound long-term strategy.

Synaptics is being acquired as a strategic asset to add connected compute capabilities. While the acquisition is positive for ON Semiconductor's growth prospects, the article provides limited independent analysis of Synaptics' standalone prospects or valuation.
Mentioned only in context of ON Semiconductor's existing partnership to create power chips for data centers. No new developments or sentiment drivers specific to Nvidia are discussed in the article.

title: INVESTOR ALERT: Pomerantz Law Firm Investigates Claims On Behalf of Investors of ON Semiconductor Corporation - ON
author: Pomerantz Llp
description: Pomerantz LLP is investigating ON Semiconductor Corporation for potential securities fraud following its announcement of an all-stock acquisition of Synaptics Incorporated for approximately $7 billion. The deal, announced on June 25, 2026, resulted in ON Semiconductor's stock price dropping 23.66% to $90.65 per share on June 26, 2026, prompting investor concerns.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company faces a securities fraud investigation following a major acquisition announcement that triggered a significant 23.66% stock price decline, indicating investor concerns about the deal's value and potential undisclosed issues.
